status_label: DRAFT / OPEN / Ring 4 / NOT LICENSED / HELD
audit_method: Metadata and narrow-use checks against primary standards bodies, publishers, DOI records, and original sources where available. This is a citation-scope audit, not independent replication of the cited results.

entries.title: IEEE Standard for VHDL Language Reference Manual
entries.supported_use: Formal machine- and human-readable language framing and separation of a language definition from a design instance.
entries.not_evidence_of: CCDL conformance, grammar completeness, or CAS PCBA correctness.

entries.title: Statecharts: A Visual Formalism for Complex Systems
entries.supported_use: Motivation for explicit state, hierarchy, concurrency, and communication semantics.
entries.not_evidence_of: Completeness or validity of PCBA stateful semantics.

entries.title: Depth-First Search and Linear Graph Algorithms
entries.supported_use: Strongly connected component method family used to frame graph-cycle analysis.
entries.not_evidence_of: Correctness, completeness, or stability guarantees for the candidate feedback analysis.

entries.title: IEEE Standard for Floating-Point Arithmetic
entries.supported_use: Discipline around explicit numerical formats, operations, destination formats, and exceptions.
entries.not_evidence_of: Cross-runtime reproducibility or adequacy of PCBA numerical tolerances.

entries.title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
entries.supported_use: Entity, activity, agent, generation, use, and derivation provenance framing.
entries.not_evidence_of: Truth, authenticity, authority, or CAS-specific PROV-O conformance.

entries.title: International Vocabulary of Metrology - Basic and General Concepts and Associated Terms (VIM), 3rd edition
entries.supported_use: Measurement, quantity, calibration, and metrological vocabulary discipline.
entries.not_evidence_of: CAS-Ohm instrument validation, physical telemetry, or metrological traceability.

entries.title: Evaluation of Measurement Data - Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement
entries.not_evidence_of: Adequacy of a CAS-Ohm uncertainty model, calibration, or decision threshold.

entries.title: Verification and Validation of Simulation Models
entries.supported_use: Separation of conceptual-model validity, implementation verification, operational validity, and data validity.
entries.not_evidence_of: Operational validity of CAS PCBA or CAS-Ohm.

entries.title: QuickCheck: A Lightweight Tool for Random Testing of Haskell Programs
entries.supported_use: Property-oriented randomized test generation as a future testing method.
entries.required_correction: Do not cite E9 as authority for mutation testing. Either add a primary mutation-testing source or leave mutation testing as an uncited open obligation. Avoid an unqualified claim that this source establishes the complete modern shrinking practice.
entries.not_evidence_of: Existing property, fuzz, mutation, or exhaustive coverage; implementation correctness.

entries.title: Information Geometry and Its Applications
entries.supported_use: Information-geometric framing of positive probability manifolds and Fisher information geometry.
entries.not_evidence_of: Correctness of a particular binary64 implementation, cognitive validity, or projector-capacity transfer.

entries.title: Causality: Models, Reasoning, and Inference, 2nd edition
entries.supported_use: Requirement for explicit causal assumptions, identification, and intervention logic before causal interpretation.
entries.not_evidence_of: An identified CAS-Ohm causal model or causal effect.

entries.title: On Physically Similar Systems; Illustrations of the Use of Dimensional Equations
entries.supported_use: Dimensional-consistency discipline and the need for an explicit unit bridge.
entries.not_evidence_of: Physical similarity, materiality, or SI status of CAS quantities.

entries.title: Memristor-The Missing Circuit Element
entries.supported_use: Historical electrical definition of the ideal memristor and distinction between instantaneous resistance and history-dependent constitutive behavior.
entries.not_evidence_of: A physical CAS memristor, charge/flux mapping, device, material, or validated memory law.

entries.title: Memristive Devices and Systems
entries.supported_use: General internal-state framing for memristive systems and motivation for an explicitly typed history-state research profile.
entries.not_evidence_of: A CAS state equation, material device, hysteresis result, or physical electrical interpretation.

entries.title: Bayesian Calibration of Computer Models
entries.supported_use: Parameter uncertainty, model discrepancy, and predictive-validation framing for calibrated computer models.
entries.not_evidence_of: Adequacy of a CAS-Ohm fit, completed calibration, held-out prediction, or external replication.

closure_statement: The citations supply standards, definitions, and method context only. None licenses CAS/TKS truth, empirical validation, causal identification, physical materiality, safety, clinical use, regulatory status, product readiness, canon admission, public disclosure, or publication acceptance.
